data.title: AI Kill Switch Act's open-source exemption hints at U.S. dilemma over Chinese AI: Analyst
data.description: Johns Hopkins SAIS' Samm Sacks discusses why Chinese AI models could become increasingly commoditised as Beijing shifts its focus to the application layer and why exempting open-source models from the AI Kill Switch Act could actually be the U.S. looking to foster a competitive domestic open-source ecosystem.
